SEALED: This table names which arm is ours. Ruling S51: it must never travel with the pack. It is written to the reveal side only.

ours_capture.renderer_string: ANGLE (NVIDIA, Vulkan 1.4.312 (NVIDIA NVIDIA RTX A4500 (0x00002232)), NVIDIA)

why_only_1920x1080_plates: A 512x512 NATIVE crop out of a 3840x2160 plate covers a quarter of the frame area a 512x512 crop out of a 1920x1080 frame covers, so surfaces arrive magnified on one arm. That is an appearance change landing on exactly one side — the leak RI-VIS06 'how we lose' names as the one that teaches you nothing about fidelity. Restricting the reference side to the 1920x1080 plates gives exact pixel-density parity with our 1920x1080 capture and makes the crop boxes directly comparable. COST OF THE RULE, recorded rather than hidden: it excludes REF-M6 (RDR2 1921x1081 — one pixel off in both axes), REF-RD (2560x1440), REF-ER neulyiaa (3840x2160) and REF-W3 1399085215 (3840x2160), which is the whole of the Red Dead Redemption 2 holding and the daylight-overcast lighting profile with it.
why_three_plates_are_excluded_outright: REF-ER 2764130788, 2764143936 and 2764143953 carry burnt-in dialogue subtitles across the lower-centre of the frame. RI-VIS06 §D lists 'HUD, watermark, subtitle' as a leak vector and says reference shots with an overlay are unusable. Verified by eye on the contact sheet, not from metadata.
hud_constraint_on_our_side: Our frames carry a shipped HUD drawn into the WebGL canvas: status bars top-left (to about y=115), compass top-right (about x>1680, y<140), hotbar bottom-right (about x>1680, y>820). There is no HUD-off mode. Every window below is chosen to clear all three, and every crop was inspected at native resolution before sealing rather than trusted to arithmetic.

pairs.match: low-angle warm sun on built stone/timber against open sky; both mid-distance exterior architecture, no character in either window
flat daylight on a plain built masonry surface; both windows are a large, largely unbroken surface under diffuse light, which is the condition that exposes flat shading
pairs.mismatch: the first window chosen here (100,100) caught a creature limb at the frame edge. RI-VIS06 §A asks for a patch of ground, foliage, water or a material close-up, so the window was moved to plain masonry. Recorded because the move was made after looking, not before.

pairs.match: daylight on carved built stonework at mid distance; both windows are architecture with ornament and a receding plane, no character in either
pairs.mismatch: same correction as pair02 — the first window (100,100) caught a creature limb and was moved to clean carved masonry after inspection.

pairs.match: low-angle light raking across ground vegetation; both are near-field ground cover with no built form and no character
pairs.mismatch: ours is 08:00 morning sun, the plate is dusk. Both are low-angle, but the colour temperature and the direction of the key differ, and the plate is the darker of the two.

pairs.match: low ambient light with a warm local source; the question both windows put is whether shadowed regions still hold readable detail
pairs.mismatch: SUBJECT SCALE DIFFERS AND IT IS THE WEAKEST PAIR IN THE SET. Ours is a mid-distance exterior walkway at dusk; the plate is a near-field material close-up (studded leather) under lamplight. The corpus holds no 1920x1080 low-light plate at mid-distance exterior scale — the nearest, REF-ER 2764067220, is spent on pair04 and its remaining windows are darker still. Recorded rather than substituted: a judge reading this pair is comparing surfaces at different distances.
